implementation_summary: Server-side A2UI answer intake (spec §2.6). AssistantChatRequest gains a2ui_action (client->server wire envelope {version, action:{name,surfaceId,sourceComponentId?,timestamp?,context?}}) and a2ui_data_model with explicit aliases a2uiAction/a2uiDataModel (auto to_camel would emit a2Ui*). New validate_a2ui_intake(history, action_envelope, data_model, replacing_history_index) in service/conversation/a2ui_intake.py: minimal structural check to obtain surfaceId (422 'Invalid A2UI action envelope'), payload size cap A2UI_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES=65536 on json(action)+json(data_model) mirroring the legacy interactive MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (422 'Payload too large'), surface lookup by createSurface.surfaceId in stored assistant a2ui_envelopes (422 'Unknown A2UI surface'), once-only guard over stored user a2ui_action per surfaceId with the strict-equality re-answer exception on the stored answer's own history_index (ported verbatim from validate_interactive_intake — a low/foreign replacing index cannot bypass), then full envelope validation via new codemie.core.a2ui.catalog.validate_action_envelope. Returns the STORED surface envelopes so the catalog is resolved only from the server's own record; the action carries no catalogId and unknown keys (e.g. a smuggled catalogId) are rejected. validate_action_envelope is manual structural validation with extras forbidden: the SDK ships NO client_to_server JSON schema asset for 0.9.1 and its pydantic client models (a2ui.core.schema.client_to_server.A2uiClientActionMessage) pin version Literal['v0.9'] and require sourceComponentId/timestamp/context — stricter than the project's v0.9.1 wire contract (WIRE_VERSION) and the planned FE submit shape; rationale documented in-code. Handler wiring: ownership check extracted into _load_authorized_history (403 BEFORE any history read, shared with the legacy interactive path unchanged in order), new AssistantRequestHandler._validate_a2ui_action called right after _validate_interactive_response in BOTH process_request implementations (StandardAssistantHandler and A2AAssistantHandler), no-op without a2ui_action (no DB read). Legacy interactive intake path untouched.
